title: The Game That Saved a Console

scenes.text: When 1995 saw a sudden 30% sales dip, one game turned the tide
The release of *Chrono Trigger* shipped over 1.5 million copies worldwide in its first year
Its innovative battery‑backed RAM allowed players to save progress without extra hardware
A single title revived a struggling console
scenes.label: REVIVAL FACTOR
scenes.sub: How one game can rescue a platform
